deep_analysis.text: Cross-asset signals are pulling in different directions today. Gold and equities are firmer, VIX and yields are lower, yet the dollar index holds a slight bid and Bitcoin has slipped, muddying the classic risk-on read. Copper's strength hints at underlying growth optimism, but the mixed H4/H1 regime and neutral gold signal suggest no clean directional conviction yet. Headlines center on the dollar's jobs-week test, with hawkish Fed repricing offsetting soft ADP data. Traders should watch the 14:00 UTC ISM Services PMI, a key input ahead
